breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt specified both Dirichlet and periodic boundary conditions, which are contradictory. The generated specification correctly removed the mention of periodic boundary conditions and only included the Dirichlet conditions (u=0 at x=0 and x=1), which aligns with the ground truth.
